name: openviking
description: Read-only access to the owner's OpenViking memory through OAuth MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Search and read the owner's shared memory.
interface.longDescription: Connect to the owner's OpenViking MCP server with OAuth, then find and read source-backed context. The server currently exposes read-only tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find relevant context in OpenViking and cite the source paths.
